model_annotations.Chinese: This graph illustrates the sparsity ratio of SDPA output across different layers. The x-axis represents the layer count, starting from 0 and extending beyond 20 layers. The y-axis measures the sparsity ratio, which ranges from 0.0 to 1.0. There are four distinct lines on the graph, each representing a different sparsity condition. The blue dotted line indicates the sparsity ratio before a gate, starting above 0.8 and sharply dropping below 0.2 as the layers increase. The orange dotted line shows the sparsity ratio after a gate, with an average threshold at 0.33 and starting just below 0.8, then experiencing a less steep decline than the blue line. The green line represents the sparsity ratio of the average gate, with an average threshold at 0.44, which begins similarly above 0.8 and follows a descending path. The gray line is labeled as the sparsity ratio after average, indicating that for the described conditions, this value should be 0.33. This graph helps to compare the sparsity trends before entering and after exiting the designated gate across layers in the network.
model_annotations.English: The line plot displayed illustrates the sparsity ratio of SDP output for three different criteria—sparsity ratio before gate, threshold 1e-2, and after average gate. The x-axis, labeled "Layer," appears to represent sequential layers or stages, with a value range that extends from 0 to just over 15, although exact numeric details are not provided. The y-axis is labeled "Sparsity Ratio" and measures the sparsity level, with values ranging from 0.0 to 1.0, suggesting that 1.0 might represent complete sparsity. The plot includes three lines, each with distinct colors and styles: a dashed blue line for "sparsity ratio before gate, average 0.03," a dash-dot green line for "sparsity ratio after average gate, avg 0.33," and a solid orange line for "sparsity ratio after average gate, avg 0.44." The blue line remains consistently below 0.1 across all layers. The green line starts just above 0.1, peaks around layer 10, and then declines sharply to reach about 0.3 at the last visible layer. The orange line begins just below 0.3, exhibits more variability, and ends close to the 0.3 mark at the final layer. The lines show varying trends and do not intersect at any point within the visible range of the plot.
model_annotations.German: Dieses Diagramm zeigt drei Markierungen für das Sparsensitivitätsraten-Entrüebnisssignal-Dauer (SDPA) Output- für jede Leistungsgateschicht. Die x-Achse, bezeichnet als "Layer", zeigt die Schichtebenen, die von 0 bis 20 reichen. Die y-Achse zeigt den Sparsensitivitätsraten, die vom Null bis 1 reichen, was einen Spindle-Threshold von 1e-2 darstellt. Das Diagramm enthält drei verschiedene Arten von Linien. Die verdünnte grüne Linie zeigt die Sparsensitivitätsraten des Input-Bereichs. Die verdünnte orange Linie zeigt die Sparsensitivitätsraten nach der Gate-Schicht. Die verdünnte grüne Linie zeigt die Sparsensitivitätsraten nach der Gate-Schicht. Dieses Diagramm zeigt das Verzerren der Steinskächle basierend auf dem Bereich der letzten oder letzten Schicht.
